content: Talah tikin Got kin wusyep tehei ŋaiye laip

content.text: Ŋendeheiyeh kin ŋaiye Got yukur ŋende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme pe,
Wusyep si narp yer.
Kin narp topoꞌe Got, topoꞌe kin ŋahilyeh taꞌe Got.
Somoho somohonme ŋaiye ŋendeheiyeh kin pe,
Wusyep kin narp topoꞌe Got.
Pe Got ŋaname Wusyep ŋaiye ka ende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme pe, kin ŋende.
Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye nate sai pe,
yukur kin nat yaŋah ŋoinde nate sai, pakai.
Wusyep uku kin tehei ŋaiye laip,
topoꞌe laip uku kin yirise ŋaiye naŋarꞌe nal lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme.
Pe yirise luku kin naŋarꞌe nato yepelmbe pe,
yepelmbe yukur tatame ka oipe yirise luku ŋaiye naŋarꞌe.

content: Got nember miyeꞌ ende nat, naŋ kin Jon.
Kin nat ŋaiye ka ininge alaŋatme wusyep me yirise luku el lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge no, ka yisyunde wusyep uku pe, ŋoihmbwaip tinge ka teŋeime wusyep uku.
Miyeꞌ uku pe, kin yukur yirise luku, pakai. Kin nat ŋaiye ka ininge alaŋatme wusyep me yirise luku.

content.text: Yirise leꞌe pe, kin yirise bwore mise ŋaiye si nate gah kekep pe,
kin naŋarꞌe gah lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme.
Wusyep si nate gah narp kekep.
Got topoꞌe Wusyep ilyeh uku, tinge hindi yende kekep lalme,
kom lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge gah kekep yukur yetekeꞌe yoworme kin.
Kin nate ŋoto kekep ŋaiye moi jeheinge kitikin,
kom lenge moi ilyeh kin yukur hriphrip ŋaiye ka yurp topoꞌe kin.
O lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge syeꞌ hriphrip me kin,
topoꞌe tinge yambaꞌe kin pe, ŋoihmbwaip tinge teŋeime kin.
Taꞌe luku pe, kin nangange lenge luh ŋaiye ka yurp tuꞌe talah tikin Got.
Tinge yukur tahar talah tikin Got jande yaŋah lenge yai mam
ŋaiye timbit yate yarp ilyeh no, yaraꞌ lenge,
topoꞌe yukur gande ŋasande tikin miyeꞌ ŋaiye kekep, pakai.
Kom Got ŋende lenge tahar ŋambaran pe, ka yurp tuꞌe talah kin.
Wusyep uku kin nat taꞌe miyeꞌ hiꞌ pe, kin narp topoꞌe poi.
Ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip mise papararme kin.
Poi si metekeꞌe yirise miꞌ kin.
Yai naŋaꞌe wutuꞌ nalme Talah esep ilyeh uku ŋaiye kin nember nat.

content: Jon tambah nal hlaꞌ ŋanange wusyep me kin taꞌe leꞌe, “Kin miyeꞌ ilyeh uku ŋaiye somohon ŋam manange wusyep. Ŋam manange na, ‘Kin ka ot gunde ŋam, kom kin nengelyembe ŋam. Detale, kin somoho somohonme si narp yerme ŋam.’”

content.text: Ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ pe, kin paparar supulme miyeꞌ uku.
Pe ŋaiye ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ kin uku pe, kin ŋende bworerme poi lalme.
Got naŋaꞌe wusyep erŋeme nalme syep Moses
ŋaiye ka angange el lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge.
Kom ŋaiye nato Jisas Krais pe, lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme
yambaꞌe ŋoih miꞌmiꞌ topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip mise.
Yukur miyeꞌ lakai tuwei ende yetekeꞌe Got.
Talah esep ilyeh tikin Got uku pe, kin Got pe, kin narp sehei me Yai.
Taꞌe luku pe, kin ilyehe ŋaiye pasam poi Got.

content: Jon tikin Baptais ŋanange nalaŋatme wusyep
Lenge miyeꞌ embep tikin Juta yember lenge pris topoꞌ lenge Livai yasme Jerusalem yate yisilihme Jon na, “Nin lahmende liki?”
Jon yukur garnge ŋaiye ka ungwisme wusyep tinge. Kin ŋana lenge bwore bwarme na, “Ŋam yukur miyeꞌ ilyeh ŋaiye Got nalaŋatme nange ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kin.”

Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yisilihme na, “Ŋaiye taꞌe liki pe, nin lahmende? Taꞌe nin Elaija lakai?” Jon nungwisme wusyep na, “Ŋam pakai.” Pe tinge yisilihme na, “Taꞌe nin profet ilyeh ŋaiye poi marp meseperhme lono?” Kin nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Pakai.”
Taꞌe luku pe, tinge yisilihme na, “Ini poi ŋaiye nin lahmende. Poi ya plihe menge wusyep plihe mila mini lenge mitiŋ ŋaiye yember poi mat. O ŋaiye nin pe, ni ŋanange nin lahmende?”

Jon nungwisme wusyep tinge gande wusyep tikin profet Aisaia ŋaiye nainge na, “Ŋam wonge tikin miyeꞌ ende gal gal narp na tas moi gungurar ŋaiye miyeꞌ mitiŋ pakai. Yiche yihyete ŋahwikin ka yelme ŋaiye Lahmborenge ka ot.”
Lenge miyeꞌ syeꞌ uku pe, lenge Farisi yember lenge yat.

Pe tinge yate yisilihme Jon na, “Ŋaiye nin yukur miyeꞌ ilyeh ŋaiye Got nalaŋatme nange na ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin, topoꞌe nin yukur Elaija, lakai profet ende pe, detaꞌe lai ti nin gihyeꞌe pinip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge?”
Jon nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Ŋam gwihyeꞌe lenge pinip pakaiye. Kom miyeꞌ ende kin narp bumbe me yip pe, yukur yip sisyeme kin.
Kin miyeꞌ ilyeh uku ŋaiye nat gande ŋam. Kom ŋam yukur bwore tatame ŋaiye ma mesembele mwah ŋaiye ŋihip hiꞌ kin.”
Jon ŋotop lenge miyeꞌ uku ŋanange wusyep ŋanar moi Betani, nal ŋumburꞌe ŋaiye mih Jordan, luh moi ŋaiye Jon gihyeꞌe pinip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge.
Jisas kin Worsip Talah tikin Got
Nyermbe pe, Jon ŋetekeꞌe Jisas natme kin pe, Jon ŋanange na, “Yetekeꞌe! Kin Worsip Talah tikin Got, ŋaiye nongohe ŋoihmbwaip pupwa lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge tikin kekep!
Kin ŋilyeh eꞌe ŋaiye ŋam mende wah manange wusyep me kin na: miyeꞌ ende ka ot gunde ŋam, kom kin nengelyembe ŋam. Detale, kin somoho somohonme si narp yerme ŋam.
Somohon ŋam yukur sisyeme kin lahmende. Kom ŋam mate gwihyeꞌe pinip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge Israel no, ka sisyeme ŋaiye kin lahmende.”
Jon ŋanange ŋoworꞌe ember na, “Ŋam metekeꞌe Yohe Yirise nase moihlaꞌ gah taꞌe jesumbihnip nate narp kin.

Teter ŋam jinjame nange kin miyeꞌ ilyeh uku. Kom somohon ŋupe ŋaiye Got nember ŋam mat ŋaiye ma gwihyeꞌe pinip lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge pe, kin ŋana ŋam taꞌe leꞌe, ‘Na etekeꞌe Yohe Yirise ka ote guh orp miyeꞌ ende pe, kin miyeꞌ ilyeh ŋaiye ka gihyeꞌe Yohe Yirise el lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge.’”
Jon ŋanange na, “Ŋam si metekeꞌe ŋai uku ŋaiye ŋende me Jisas pe, ŋam mana yip ŋaiye kin Talah tikin Got.”
Ŋendeheiyeh ŋaiye Jisas nambaꞌ lenge jetalah
Nyermbe ŋaiye Jon gan uku pe, lenge jetalah kin hoi jan yotop kin.
O ŋupe ŋaiye kin ŋetekeꞌe Jisas nat nal pe, kin ŋanange na, “Yetekeꞌe! Luku Worsip Talah tikin Got.”
Lenge jetalah hoi tikin Jon yisande wusyep ŋaiye Jon ŋanange pe, tinge yal topoꞌe Jisas.
Jisas bunjenge ŋetekeꞌe tinge hindi ŋaiye jande kin yal pe, kin ŋisilih lenge na, “Yip hindi yahaiꞌe ŋaimune?” Tinge yungwisme wusyep kin na, “Jetmam, nin narp pa?”

Jisas nungwisme wusyep tinge na, “Yip yute yetekeꞌe.” Pe tinge yal topoꞌe kin ya yetekeꞌe luh moi ŋaiye kin narp pe, tinge yarp topoꞌe kin ŋaiye ŋau yungwiris yeh uku. Ki taꞌe ŋaiye ŋau ambaꞌe hoye hoye ŋaiye yungwiris.
Miyeꞌ ŋoinde ŋaiye tinge hindi hoime yisande wusyep Jon pe, naŋ kin Andru. Kin toꞌ tikin Saimon Pita.

Nilyehe sai, kin nal ŋetekeꞌe tatai kin Saimon pe, kin ŋaname na, “Poi si metekeꞌe Mesaia.” Naŋ tehei Mesaia pe, ki taꞌe leꞌe, Miyeꞌ ŋaiye Got nalaŋatme nange ka ungwisme lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge kitikin.

Miꞌe pe, Andru nambaꞌe Saimon nenge nalme Jisas. Jisas ŋembep nal ŋusukumbe miꞌe pe, kin ŋaname na, “Nin Saimon, talah tikin Jon. Kom ma gwil naŋ nin Sipas.” Naŋ uku ki ŋahilyeh taꞌe Pita, topoꞌe naŋ tehei kin ŋeser.
Jisas gal lenge Filip hindi Nataniel
Nyermbe pe, Jisas ŋoiheryembe ŋaiye ka el distrik Galili. Kin ŋetekeꞌe Filip pe, kin ŋaname na, “Ot topoꞌme ŋam!”
Filip kin miyeꞌ tikin moi embere Betsaida ŋaiye moi jeheinge tititinge Andru hindi Pita.

Filip nal ŋetekeꞌe Nataniel pe, kin ŋaname na, “Poi si metekeꞌe miyeꞌ ŋaiye Moses nainge wusyep me kin sai nato tup tikin wusyep erŋeme, topoꞌe lenge profet yainge wusyep me kin. Kin Jisas tikin moi embere Nasaret, topoꞌe kin talah Josep.”
Nataniel ŋanange na, “Ŋam sisyeme, yukur ŋainde bwore ka tuhur si oto Nasaret.” Pe Filip ŋaname na, “Ni ote etekeꞌe!”
Ŋupe ŋaiye Nataniel nate ŋetekeꞌe Jisas pe, Jisas ŋaname na, “Yetekeꞌe! Kin miyeꞌ Israel bwore mise. Yukur ŋainde pupwa homboꞌe sai nato kin.”
O Nataniel ŋisilihme Jisas na, “Nin sisyeme ŋam taꞌe lai?” Jisas nungwisme wusyep kin na, “Teter ŋaiye Filip yukur gal nin ŋaiye na ot pe, ŋam si metekeꞌ nin ŋaiye nin narp lou ŋip tuwihe.”
Nataniel nungwisme wusyep kin na, “Jetmam, nin talah tikin Got! Nin kiŋ titinge lenge Israel!”

Jisas nungwisme wusyep kin na, “Ŋam mana nin nange ŋam metekeꞌ nin narp lou ŋip tuwihe pe, luku tehei ŋaiye ŋoihmbwaip nin teŋeime ŋam, lakai? Mindemboi na etekeꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe syeꞌ ki ŋembere nengelyembe leꞌe.”
Pe Jisas ŋana lenge na, “Ŋam mana yip bwore mise! Pa yetekeꞌe moihlaꞌ ka hohou si pe, lenge walip hlaꞌ tikin Got ka juh yunuh jin luh ŋaiye Talah tikin Miyeꞌ narp.”

footnotes.text: 1.48 Jon nainge lou fik, kom poi mainge lou ŋip.
